newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR steady to marginally lower.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR steady to marginally lower.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) were mostly steady to marginally lower as banks remained cautious despite a liquid market, traders said.
"We're not yet sure how rates will go in the coming weeks," one trader said, adding that many traders were preparing for a possible long New Year's weekend.
They said the government could announce a special holiday for December 31, which falls between two national holidays.
Swap rates were slightly lower at the short end of the curve following the marginal dip in their corresponding spot rates. Only the one-year rate inched up to 11.6875 percent.
